system.roleplaying: You are loyal to more than one organization, possibly working at cross purposes. You always cover your tracks.
system.minorTwist: What were you just forced to do that seemed strange to your current allies?
system.majorTwist: Will you shatter your trust with your current allies or forfeit what your other allegiance offers?

greenAbility.name: Principle of the Double Agent
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome in a situation where you can draw upon resources from your other organization and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
